document_title: Publication of Iran-Related Web General Licenses U and V

claims.quote: (a) Except as provided in paragraph (b), all transactions prohibited by the above-listed authorities that are ordinarily incident and necessary to the sale, delivery, or offloading of crude oil or petroleum products of Iranian origin loaded on any vessel, including vessels blocked under the above-listed authorities, on or before 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time, March 20, 2026 are authorized through 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time, April 19, 2026.
claims.affected_party: parties involved in transactions with Iranian-origin crude oil or petroleum products
claims.summary: Transactions related to the sale, delivery, or offloading of Iranian-origin crude oil or petroleum products are authorized until April 19, 2026, provided they are ordinarily incident and necessary to such activities.

claims.quote: Note 1 to paragraph (a). Transactions that are ordinarily incident and necessary to the sale, delivery, or offloading of such crude oil or petroleum products include transactions for the safe docking and anchoring of vessels carrying such crude oil or petroleum products; the preservation of the health or safety of the crew of any such vessel; emergency repairs or environmental mitigation or protection activities relating to any such vessel; and services such as vessel management, crewing, bunkering, piloting, registration, flagging, insurance, classification, and salvage.
claims.affected_party: parties involved in transactions with Iranian-origin crude oil or petroleum products
claims.summary: Transactions for safe docking, crew safety, emergency repairs, environmental mitigation, and vessel-related services are included in the authorized activities.

claims.quote: Note 2 to paragraph (a). Transactions authorized by this general license include the importation into the United States of crude oil and petroleum products of Iranian origin, where such importation is ordinarily incident and necessary to the sale, delivery, or offloading of such crude oil or petroleum products authorized by this general license.
claims.affected_party: parties involved in transactions with Iranian-origin crude oil or petroleum products
claims.summary: Importation of Iranian-origin crude oil and petroleum products into the U.S. is authorized if it is ordinarily incident and necessary to the sale, delivery, or offloading of such products.

claims.quote: (a) Except as provided in paragraph (b) of this general license, all transactions prohibited by Executive Order (E.O.) 13902 that are ordinarily incident and necessary to the wind down of any transaction involving Hengli Petrochemical (Dalian) Refinery Co., Ltd. (Hengli Petrochemical), or any entity in which Hengli Petrochemical owns, directly or indirectly, a 50 percent or greater interest, are authorized through 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time, May 24, 2026, provided that any payment to a blocked person must be made into a blocked, interest-bearing account located in the United States.
claims.affected_party: parties involved in transactions with Hengli Petrochemical or related entities
claims.summary: Transactions related to the wind down of transactions involving Hengli Petrochemical or related entities are authorized until May 24, 2026, with payments to blocked persons required to be made into blocked, interest-bearing accounts in the U.S.

claims.quote: (b) This general license does not authorize any transactions otherwise prohibited by E.O. 13902, including transactions involving any person blocked pursuant to E.O. 13902 other than the blocked persons described in paragraph (a) of this general license, unless separately authorized.
claims.affected_party: parties involved in transactions with blocked persons under E.O. 13902
claims.summary: Transactions involving persons blocked under E.O. 13902, except those described in paragraph (a), are prohibited unless separately authorized.

claims.quote: (b) This general license does not authorize: (1) Any transaction involving a person located in or organized under the laws of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, the Republic of Cuba, the Covered Regions of Ukraine, as defined by E.O. 14065, the Crimea Region of Ukraine, as defined by E.O. 13685, or any entity that is owned or controlled by or in a joint venture with such persons; or (2) Any other transactions or activities prohibited by any other Executive order or by any part of 31 CFR chapter V not referenced in this general license.
claims.affected_party: parties involved in transactions with persons from specific countries or entities
claims.summary: Transactions involving persons from the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Cuba, Covered Regions of Ukraine, Crimea Region of Ukraine, or entities owned/controlled by such persons are prohibited. Additionally, any other transactions prohibited by other Executive orders or parts of 31 CFR chapter V not referenced are also prohibited.
